_meta.rule: EU-27 ISO-3166-1 alpha-2 codes of countries where the company itself lists a station/depot (or, for peer-to-peer platforms, offers listings) on its own website on sourceCheckedOn; non-EU countries seen there are only counted in nonEuCountries; nothing inferred.

providers.note: Station REST endpoint (read with header X-Locale: en) returns 96 stations in 17 distinct country codes, while the About page slide says '16 countries' and 'more than 100 stations'.

The 'RV Rental Locations' block lists 91 stations under 16 labels; England and Scotland are separate labels but one ISO country (GB), so 15 countries, while the About page says '16 countries' and 'around 100 locations'. The rv-rental-europe page names Denmark among countries with roadsurfer rentals, but no Danish station is listed.

Owned-fleet depot list ('Global Pick-up Locations (Depots)') on the fact sheet: 107 entries in 23 countries; the Italy list contains both 'Bergamo' and 'Milan Bergamo', so the true count may be 106. The where-we-are page additionally lists marketplace-served cities (e.g. Belfast) which are not depots and were not taken.
Station REST endpoint (read with header X-Locale: en) returns 42 stations in 13 countries, while the homepage says 'over 50 stations'. Brand is merging into McRent on 2026-11-16.

Agencies page lists 30 agencies in FR (24, incl. Reunion Island), CH (2), IE (2), GR (1) and CA (1). The 'Qui sommes-nous' page instead claims 'more than 50 agencies' in France, Belgium, Switzerland, Italy, Ireland and Portugal; BE, IT and PT have no agency on the agencies page, GR is absent from the about text.
Locations page lists 15 stations, all with German postal addresses, while the same page says '14+ stations'. One entry is labelled 'DRM Leeds' but carries a Leipzig address.
Station REST endpoint (read with header X-Locale: en) returns 14 stations: DE 12, SE 1, GB 1. The holding page (dated 10/2022) claimed 23 stations incl. one in CH; no CH station is present today.
Rental-locations page lists 10 offices in 8 countries: FI 2, NO 2, IS 1, SE 1, NL 1, ES 1, EE 1, GB 1.

Peer-to-peer platform without depots: countries are those listed on the homepage under 'RV rental in Europe' (18 countries) and 'around the world' (CA, US, AU), i.e. where private-owner listings are offered.

Peer-to-peer platform without depots: countries are those with a PaulCamper site (paulcamper.de/.at/.nl). The homepage says 'at home in six countries' but lists six besides Germany (seven in total); ES, GB, AU and NZ are served through the sister brand Camplify on separate domains and are not counted here.
